## v0.5.4 · Memory Space Terminology

v0.5.4 standardizes “memory space” / “记忆空间” throughout the product and codebase, and keeps longer labels usable on narrow screens.

### Changes

- Align Chinese and English UI, accessibility labels, Agent guidance, command output, SDK terminology, published READMEs, guides, and editable diagrams.
- Add canonical `MemorySpace` models and service names while preserving deprecated aliases, existing Provider contexts and subclasses, tool/RPC fields, and stored data formats. User-authored names remain unchanged.
- Wrap narrow directory actions, Provider metadata, and storage badges; adjust navigation spacing for longer labels.
- Refresh bilingual desktop and narrow-screen UI evidence with eighteen original screenshots and recorded layout measurements.

Implementation: [#194](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/194).

### Packages and upgrade

The Starter and all sixteen official plugins advance to `0.5.4` because each has changed code or published documentation. The Starter pins the full tested composition; independent package versioning remains in effect.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.4
```

Use `headless` for a Headless Profile, then restart DSH. Mnemon CLI remains separately installed and maintained through `@mnemon-dev/mnemon` on npm.

No storage migration is required. Existing IDs, Provider connections, authorization, and data remain compatible. Rollback uses `dsh-mnemon@0.5.3` in the same Profile; separately updated plugins must be restored separately. The workflow verifies frozen artifacts, npm read-back, a clean complete install, and a real Registry upgrade from v0.4.7 before creating this release.

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.4/docs/en/releases/v0.5.4.md), [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.4/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.4.md), and [bilingual UI evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.4/docs/assets/memory-space-terminology/README.md) for compatibility, screenshots, and validation limits. The screenshots predate versioning and show the v0.5.3 capture base with the changes now released in v0.5.4.
